plan.title: Repetition Detector
plan.narrative: Implement algorithmic repetition detection as a pre-processing step during ingestion. Uses tf-idf for term frequency analysis and fuzzy matching for phrase/structure reuse detection. Outputs structured data (word frequencies, repeated phrases, sentence structure patterns, dialogue tag distribution) stored in LangGraph state for consumption by the Prose Analyst. This runs outside the LLM — deterministic and reliable. Traces: FR-12.

items.title: Word and phrase frequency analysis
items.narrative: tf-idf based detection of overused words and phrases across the manuscript. Output: ranked list with counts and locations.

items.title: Sentence structure patterns
items.narrative: Detect repeated sentence openings, similar sentence lengths, and structural monotony. Fuzzy matching for near-duplicate constructions.

items.title: Dialogue tag analysis
items.narrative: Count and categorize dialogue tags (said, whispered, exclaimed, etc.). Flag over-reliance on specific tags or adverb-heavy tags.
